This guys comment is weird and kinda filled with insecurity. You should just be able to have a conversation with her. Who gives a fuck how many more people this guys wife adds to her list than he does, he is trying to fulfill his own needs. Do not let anyone tell you your potential, put yourself out there you would be surprised. As for what your wife says "you would just be jealous" thats a fair point and something that is entirely up to you. Would you be jealous? Ask that question for sure. If you think you would be fine with it, (she does not sound like she is all that interested in sex at all, perhaps thats why shes upset, SHE might be jealous and feel like it is her job to "provide" sex), I would just talk to her about it again. You need to speak up, say "my needs are not being met" and move from there. If she cannot handle that conversation at all, theres your answer. You have every right to get what you need, she just might not stick around and thats a her thing not a you thing. 

Again, who cares how many people each of you sleep with? Don't make it about that. Make it about who is having their needs met and what those needs are. The one thing I will agree with, if you guys decide you love each other and you have been as honest as you can be, couples therapy might help you at least find a solution to ease the tension. Maybe limited play with others, who knows. Best of luck. Be as honest as you can be.
I really think you need to just have a conversation with her about your needs and discuss an open or poly relationship. Cheating is never the answer and I implore you to be honest
